## Disk usage alert (Cedar Rack)

Built-in nodes only. No secrets are stored in this workflow.

1. n8n 2 disables Execute Command unless you set NODES_EXCLUDE=[].
2. The command is `df -P -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs`. On BusyBox df (the official image) `-x` is missing, so the same node falls back to `df -PT`. The Code node drops tmpfs and devtmpfs either way.
3. Edit the Set node. threshold_percent defaults to 85. A filesystem is over when capacity_percent is at or above that number.
4. Hourly schedule and Manual Trigger run the same check. They do not call Respond to Webhook.
5. POST /webhook/disk-check runs the same check and responds with JSON: ok, threshold, over, filesystems.
6. Telegram and Email ship disabled. Create credentials named "Telegram account" and "SMTP account", select them, then enable the node. Chat id YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. From alerts@example.com to ops@example.com.
7. Docker df sees the container filesystem. Run n8n on the host when you want the host's disks.
